name: What are elevations in architectural drawings?

mainEntity.name: What are elevations in architectural drawings?

acceptedAnswer.text: Elevations are two-dimensional views of the exterior walls showing height, materials, windows, doors, rooflines, and trim to guide siding, fenestration, and detailing.
